coord.situation: The hospital is operating close to full capacity with the highest pressure concentrated in Emergency and ICU. The next 6 hours are manageable if planned discharges convert on time.
coord.recommendedMeta: Highest-leverage move for the current situation

coord.reason2: Medicine has 11 beds nominally available, but 4 are blocked by discharge workflow.
coord.reason3: ICU has only a 3-bed operational buffer against the overnight forecast.
coord.priority3: Reduce ER boarding before evening arrival peak
coord.ownerMeta: Suggested teams to bring into the huddle

insight.i1.title: ER boarding time is above operating threshold
insight.i1.summary: 12 admitted patients are waiting for an inpatient bed. Median boarding time is 3h 18m.
insight.i1.why: Medicine occupancy reached 91% after a higher-than-expected respiratory admission block this morning.
insight.i1.impact: If unchanged, ER wait time is likely to exceed 58 minutes by 18:00.
insight.i1.action: Prioritize 4 Medicine discharges and open the flex observation pod by 16:00.
insight.i2.title: ICU capacity tightening over next 12 hours
insight.i2.summary: Three beds are available now; forecast occupancy peaks at 94% overnight.
insight.i2.why: Two transfers from Surgery are clinically ready and one expected admission is already in transit.
insight.i2.impact: A delayed discharge would remove the only safe buffer for overnight demand.
insight.i2.action: Confirm step-down placement for two patients before 17:30.
insight.i3.title: Discharge pace is 2 patients behind plan
insight.i3.summary: 7 of 9 planned discharges are complete at 14:20.
insight.i3.why: Pharmacy reconciliation is pending on two patients in the east pod.
insight.i3.impact: Bed turnover is delayed at the same time as ER demand is rising.
insight.i3.action: Escalate pharmacy reconciliation and target completion by 15:30.
insight.i4.title: Operating room schedule has regained buffer
insight.i4.summary: Two elective cases moved to tomorrow, releasing 3 beds this afternoon.
insight.i4.why: The perioperative team adjusted sequencing after a shorter trauma list.
insight.i4.impact: Bed availability improves for evening transfers.
insight.i4.action: Offer one released bed to the ICU step-down queue.
